answer: Pay bounties from the fake's own stake to anyone who proves an identity is a duplicate. Each identity locks a deposit; when an investigator presents evidence, a jury checks it through a prism of separate signals - shared keys, repeated behavior, matching wallets - and if fraud is confirmed the deposit funds the bounty. The kernel of the defense is arithmetic: at its nadir of profitability a sybil farm must pay a bounty every time one of its identities is caught, so each extra fake identity becomes a liability, not free capacity.
